new_value: Made RplRuntime generation binding total by replacing the generation-0 sentinel with Option<u64>, so wrapped generation zero remains bound. Added state-transition tests proving pending polls reject without mutation, stale completion preserves the original pending action, wrong-generation polls remain rejected after completion, and generation zero cannot rebind. Added RplStack integration coverage proving a generation bump rejects the stale receive action before radio.receive and a fresh runtime binds to the new generation. Green: 12 focused runtime tests; full lichen-node 249/249 unit tests plus all integrations; strict Clippy; no-default-features; package fmt/diff check.
